answer.reason: Successful compilation of a supported XPath variable reference requires a populated variable set. Both branches of the complete old entry construct the query without one, so that behavior is unreachable.
answer.finite_witness: Fuzzer bytes 0x24 0x78 form "$x". A live xpath_variable_set with x set to true would support compiling this query through xpath_query("$x", &variables). The old entry passes only the text, so parsing rejects the reference.

scope_contract.reason: The target's primary operation is XPath query construction, whose contract accepts a variable set for expressions containing variable references.

feasible_trigger.reason: "$x" is a finite recognized variable reference; the source supports a live set containing boolean x, but the entry has no route to supply that setup.

observable_consequence.reason: With the entry's null default variable set, the parser rejects "$x" before constructing its variable AST node; successful compilation of that supported reference cannot occur.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete entry has only one query construction in each compile-time branch, both without a variable set. Input bytes can change the expression but cannot create or pass the required object. Quoting "$x" produces a string constant, not a variable reference.

identity_preserved.reason: The assessed tuple remains compilation of "$x" with a populated live variable set, blocked by the old entry's null set. No before-source timing conclusion is made.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Compile the XPath variable reference "$x" with x supplied by a live xpath_variable_set.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Create xpath_variable_set, set x to true, and keep the set live while constructing xpath_query("$x", &variables).
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: Both old entry branches call xpath_query(text), selecting the null variable-set default.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Successful compilation of a variable-reference expression.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: None in the complete old entry; query bytes cannot supply a variable-set object, and quoted "$x" is a string constant.
